hook: SHE WAITS ALL DAY FOR *SOMEONE TO *TALK
title: F39 · nobody_has_time · Dadi's Phone Never Rings
lines: n
Everyone leaves by nine. They come back at seven.
n
That is ten hours. She has counted.
n
She has stories. Nobody has time.
n
So she tells them to the only one who is always home.
n
You will not believe what the vegetable man charged today.
"You will not believe what the vegetable man charged today."
n
She talks. He listens. It is the oldest friendship in the house.
n
Kabir came home early that day and stood in the hall, hearing her.
n
He sat down in the empty chair.
Then what did the vegetable man say?
"Then what did the vegetable man say?"
n
Being listened to is the whole prayer. Be the one who listens. That is sadhana.
n
Kailasa. On Google Play.
